ov: وراثي (بالإنجليزية: Hereditary) فيلم رعب أمريكي خارق للطبيعة من كتابة وإخراج آري أستر ومن بطولة توني كوليت وأليكس وولف وميلي شابيرو وغابريل بيرن في دور عائلة يطاردها كائن غامض بعد وفاة جدتهم المتحفظة. عُرض الفيلم لأول مرة في 21 يناير 2018 في قسم منتصف الليل من نسخة 2018 من مهرجان صاندانس السينمائي. وصدر لصالات السينما في الولايات المتحدة في 8 يونيو 2018. وحقق الفيلم نجاحًا كبيرًا على الصعيدين التجاري والنقدي حيث وصلت أرباحه إلى أكثر من 80 مليون دولار أمريكي وذلك مقابل ميزانية قدرها 10 ملايين دولار ليصبح بذلك فيلمَ شركةِ إيه 24 الذي حقق الإيرادات الأعلى على مستوى العالم.
plotEn:
Miniatures artist Annie Graham lives in Utah with her psychiatrist husband Steve and their two children, 16-year-old son Peter and 13-year-old daughter Charlie. The family attends the funeral of Annie's estranged mother, Ellen. Annie is surprised by the number of mourners in attendance. After the funeral, Charlie becomes withdrawn and sullen; at school, she beheads a dead bird with scissors and pockets the head. At a bereavement support group, Annie reveals that she and her mother had a strained relationship, though Ellen largely raised Charlie. Meanwhile, Steve learns that Ellen's gravesite has been desecrated, a fact he keeps from Annie.
Peter is invited to a party, and Annie insists that Charlie accompany him. Left unattended, Charlie eats a piece of cake containing walnuts, triggering her severe nut allergy and sending her into anaphylactic shock. As Peter drives Charlie to the hospital, she leans out of the window to gasp for air. Peter swerves to avoid a dead deer in the road, and Charlie is decapitated by a telephone pole. In shock, Peter drives home and leaves Charlie's headless body in Annie's car, which she discovers the next morning.
Following Charlie's funeral, Peter becomes reclusive and guilt-stricken, Annie becomes bitter and resentful toward Peter, and Steve tries to mediate between them.
